title: Goldman Sachs’ India Portfolio; 10 stocks rally up to 130% in CY26
text: Goldman Sachs’ India Portfolio; 10 stocks rally up to 130% in CY26. Despite the overall decline, 10 stocks delivered gains ranging from 20% to 130% during the period. CMR Green Technologies was a newly added stock to the portfolio during the June 2026 quarter
